objective: Make Cloud IaC reusable OpenTofu module provider requirements code-backed by materializing explicit required_providers HCL in each local module and adding a fail-closed Oya gate that binds those HCL declarations to provider-readiness.json, while preserving no provider configuration/resources, module-tree lockfiles, provider install-in-source, plan/apply, signing, SLSA/VSA, private registry runtime, or cloud provisioning claims.

best_practice_sources.evidence_used: OpenTofu requires modules to declare provider requirements with local names, explicit source addresses, and version constraints; this ChangeSet materializes those declarations.
Reusable modules declare required providers but must not contain provider configuration blocks; parent/root configurations own provider configuration.
Local reusable modules remain repo-local source paths; no remote registry/download/archive claim is made.
SLSA/VSA attestations remain explicit future non-claims for this HCL materialization slice.

implemented_claims: Added oya gate validate cloud-iac-module-provider-requirements with repo-local defaults for manifest, catalog, and provider-readiness paths.
Materialized explicit terraform.required_providers HCL in all six reusable local OpenTofu module main.tofu files.

Updated provider-readiness policy/status and module flags to reflect HCL materialization while keeping provider lockfiles, provider resources, provider configuration, provider installation, provider provenance, signing, SLSA/VSA, tofu test/plan/apply, and cloud provisioning false.
Refreshed module provenance and release-index SHA-256 file digests for the changed module HCL.
Registered the new gate in the CLI usage, dispatcher, run-all catalog, and foundry gate catalog.

no provider resource or data-source implementation
no provider lockfiles in reusable module trees
no provider installation cache in source
no provider provenance verification summary or VSA

false_green_findings_closed: Provider-readiness could previously list intended families without code-backed module HCL; reusable modules now carry explicit required_providers declarations and a gate rejects drift.
HCL materialization is truth-downed to provider requirements only; provider configuration/resource/data/backend blocks and module-tree lockfiles fail closed.
Module provenance and release index digests now bind the materialized HCL bytes instead of stale skeleton bytes.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed by this ChangeSet; previous unrelated app-shell compile/evidence and ADR-shape blockers remain outside this slice.

Cloud IaC still needs future slices for provider-resource-complete modules, module archive build, private registry service/discovery/download endpoints, module signing/Sigstore/cosign, SLSA/VSA attestations, independent provider provenance verification, tofu tests, plan/apply evidence, and live GitOps/provider integration evidence.

findings: Small direct gate with no new Rust dependency; validates JSON/path/HCL coherence and rejects runtime overclaims.
Moves Cloud IaC from provider inventory metadata toward reusable module contract code while preserving strict runtime non-claims.
Tests cover missing provider HCL, source drift, provider configuration overclaim, and lane registration.
Command has repo-local defaults and reports modules/provider requirements checked.
Focused tests, live gate, Cloud IaC regressions, scoped fmt/check/clippy, catalog tests, and default run-all passed.

Gate rejects provider configuration, credential-like markers, generated lock/state/tfvars/plan artifacts, and module-tree provider install caches.
Gate is bounded local JSON/HCL/filesystem validation; OpenTofu validation remains temp-copy based.
SLSA/VSA remain future non-claims; no attestation is generated.
Existing Cloud IaC catalog/provenance/release-index/provider-readiness/lock/signature gates remain green.
Run-all includes the new gate; OpenTofu validation passed with temp copies and no source-tree generated artifacts.
